newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-First Boston ups AK Steel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-First Boston ups AK Steel.

text.p: -- CS First Boston raised its rating of AK Steel Holding Corp to buy from hold.
-- CS First Boston analyst Tom Abrams said he sees several positives in AK Steel, such as high current profitability and good contract exposure.
-- Due to AK Steel's potential for growth and earnings, the company is the only stock Abrams is recommending in the steel group.

-- Abrams sees AK Steel trading at 9.2 times "trough" earnings estimates. On a consensus basis, analysts estimate AK Steel will earn $4.70 a share in 1996 and $4.66 a share in 1997, according to First Call.
-- AK Steel gained 1/4 to 39-3/8 in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
